General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This part is the Suzuki OEM metal covers that goes over the upper boot for the transfer case shifter.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 Upper Boot COVER for Transfer case Shifter
Qty 4 Attachment Screws
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
